description: Aggregates images/flavors/keypairs/networks/security groups into human-friendly choices. Does not create anything. Happy path: import_keypair → plan_instance → create_instance → get_ssh_command. Call this second (after import_keypair, if you have no keypairs).

image_role.description: Free hosting runtime role; the backend resolves the private image. Not an image ID.

provisioning_mode.description: Explicit hosting choice. Free uses the account entitlement and server-owned image/size; it never falls back to paid. Omit to keep paid hosting.

required_disk_gb.description: Minimum root disk required by the app. Free hosting never grows the disk or silently charges for a larger size.

required_memory_mb.description: Minimum memory required by the app, including builds; free hosting refuses requirements beyond its fixed size.

name: plan_instance
title: Plan instance (guided options)
